# vendor/hydrawn-board

The built `@hydrawn/board` library (hydrawn `packages/board/dist`), at the hydrawn commit in
`VERSION`. Generated: refresh with `scripts/vendor-hydrawn-board.sh <hydrawn checkout>`, never
edit by hand. `index.d.ts` and this file are osionos' own.

Loaded only by `src/features/whiteboard/model/inProcessBoard.ts`, through a dynamic import,
behind the `osio.whiteboard.inprocess` flag (default off).
